summary: The 557202 graduated (also called “displacement”) target decal is useful for estimating deviations from a straight line when you’re beyond the range of your optical micrometer. Black on matte white, with graduations in each quadrant reading from the center in 0.050″ increments and numbered every 0.200″. Peel-off type backing; targets come in packages of 10.
specs: Pattern: black on matte white background
Catalog listing: Brunson Target Decal 2.5. Graduated. Pack Of 10.
